previous_statement: Let V=Z dot X, so componentwise V_i=sum_j Z_ij dot X_j. The corner-product typing in the H-CB datum sends S_{P,R} dot S_{R,Q} into S_{P,Q}; closure under finite sums therefore gives V in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}. This is a typing statement and uses no associativity of dot.
new_statement: Under the exact allowed inputs, the typing conclusion V=Z dot X in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} is not derivable. The registered def-ha-map uses Z dot X only as an ambient expression in its defining identity and does not assert Z dot X in S_{P,Q}; def-hcb-datum packages corresponding compressed corners and amplified spaces but states no corner-product closure, no formula A dot B=Co_{P,Q}(AB), and no identification S_{P,Q}=Im(Co_{P,Q}). The amplified-compression dependency supplies only idempotence and dagger compatibility, which cannot provide any of those missing links, while the column-Hilbert estimate applies only after membership in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q} is known. Thus node 1.3.2 cannot be applied to V from these inputs, and node 1.3 and the root proof require an additional allowed corner-product typing axiom or lemma.
